77.72849,12.95635.name: Baby Sciences IVF Clinic Pvt Ltd
77.72849,12.95635.desc: A clinic mapped in OpenStreetMap as offering fertility treatment. OpenStreetMap holds what somebody chose to map, so a country with few points here may be thinly mapped rather than thinly served. That is the reverse of the national registers alongside it, which are close to complete for one country and silent everywhere else. This layer is a cross-check and a source of leads, not a count.

-88.11248,30.25420.name: Center for Food Safety and Applied Nutrition
-88.11248,30.25420.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-73.58076,45.50921.name: Montréal Heart Institute
-73.58076,45.50921.status: Certificate of GAP Last visit: interim, September 2023
-73.58076,45.50921.desc: An institution certified by the Canadian Council on Animal Care for its use of animals in science. Certificate of GAP Last visit: interim, September 2023. CCAC certification is a condition of federal research funding rather than a licence, so an institution outside it is not necessarily outside the work — it may simply not take federal money. The CCAC publishes names and certificate status and no addresses, so this point marks the institution rather than the building where animals are held.

-43.37434,-22.95838.name: Day Clinic Rio Sul
-43.37434,-22.95838.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: www.clinicadale.com.br. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere. No street address resolved, so this point is the city or the country rather than the centre.

9.94500,53.55800.desc: A drug discovery and development contractor that runs research programmes for pharmaceutical clients, including gene and cell therapy work. It is the European end of the arrangement in which the evidence for approval is generated by companies the applicant hires — the same structure as the American contract laboratories, with the same dependency on repeat business.

36.72000,-1.27000.name: ISAAA AfriCenter
36.72000,-1.27000.state: Nairobi — ILRI Campus, Old Naivasha Rd
36.72000,-1.27000.desc: The African office of the industry-funded biotechnology information service, producing the adoption figures and briefings widely cited in African policy debate. Its numbers are the most quoted on the continent and its funding comes from the industry whose adoption it counts, which is worth knowing when the figures appear in a parliamentary submission.

-77.03300,38.89400.name: Bureau of Industry and Security — commerce control list
-77.03300,38.89400.state: Washington DC — US Department of Commerce
-77.03300,38.89400.desc: Partly or fully automated nucleic acid assemblers and synthesisers capable of more than 1.5 kilobases sit on this bureau's control list and on the Australia Group list, and those export controls are, according to arms control analysts, the only consistently applied regulation of benchtop synthesis devices anywhere. Several US bills to require screening of synthesis products have been introduced since 2023 and none has moved past introduction. The position this leaves is worth stating flatly: the machines are controlled as EXPORTS, which governs where they may be sold, while what is synthesised on one already sold is governed by nothing binding. That is the same shape as the gamete courier and the grain shipment elsewhere on this map — a rule attached to crossing a border rather than to the act itself.
